title: THE CONTROLS LIST STAYS OUT OF A RECORDING
why: Seen on the first real attract clip (2026-10-09): the clip carried the on-screen controls list (WASD move, CTRL crouch and the rest), which clutters a gameplay reel. While F9 records, the list is now not drawn; it comes back the moment the recording stops.
now: While you record with F9, the controls list is hidden so the clip shows clean gameplay.
